entries.root_cause: The recovery-proxy preflight audited only routines whose owner was exactly jlmirror_wave4_recovery_authority. A different non-superuser principal with immediately inherited recovery-role USAGE could own a callable or trigger-bound SECURITY DEFINER wrapper and dynamically exercise the newly granted cross-tenant recovery entry points, bypassing both exact-owner scans.
horizontal_audit: member-owned retained trigger and expression dependencies
non-inheriting memberships that require explicit SET ROLE
future grants to shared capability roles with inheriting members
